scheduleJST: 毎日 07:07 頃（GitHub Actions cron: 22:07 UTC）
adoptionGate: API-free; strict same-offer verifier checks + complete collection; candidate output only

productionAdoption.note: V30 may add a verified game and its strict offers to production; scheduled refresh stays disabled until a controlled refresh policy is enabled.

retrievalStrategy: direct first-party HTTP across bounded stable official listing/editorial pages; query selectors are preserved only from an allowlist; Firecrawl best-effort fallback only
confidenceStrategy: deterministic evidence confidence; Gemini extracts names only and cannot promote a single-source candidate by confidence
identityStrategy: deterministic conservative campaign-decoration normalization (platform/provider prefixes + trailing StepUp only); thresholds unchanged
extractionStrategy: bounded long-page chunking; no silent 5000-character tail truncation; same page/chunks remain one source identity
researchRecheckStrategy: requeue previously researched promoted games once when researchLogicVersion changes; unchanged logic stays cached
